sections.content: Changing eating habits often requires explaining a reason, describing what happened and evaluating the result. Combine past narration, present habits, comparisons and recommendation language. Connectors such as al *principio*, después, sin embargo, por eso and con el *tiempo* help turn separate sentences into a coherent account.

items.spanish: Al principio cocinaba muy poco, pero con el tiempo aprendí a preparar platos más equilibrados.
items.english: At first I cooked very little, but over time I learned to prepare more balanced dishes.

items.spanish: Decidí sustituir algunos productos preparados porque quería comer de forma más saludable.
items.english: I decided to replace some prepared products because I wanted to eat more healthily.

items.spanish: Al principio fue difícil mantener el cambio, aunque ahora forma parte de mi vida cotidiana.
items.english: At first it was difficult to maintain the change, although now it is part of my everyday life.

items.spanish: Como el cambio funcionó bien, decidí mantener algunas de aquellas nuevas costumbres.
items.english: As the change worked well, I decided to maintain some of those new habits.

sections.content: Use connectors to show stages, causes and contrasts so that an account of changing habits becomes a connected narrative.
